mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id, dp.ticker, dp.name FROM account a JOIN domestic_stock_balance b ON b.account_id = a.account_id JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE b.qty > 0 AND b.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') AND dp.type = 'STOCK' AND dp.ticker REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' AND dp.name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dp.name) != '' ORDER BY a.customer_id, dp.ticker, dp.name

SELECT dp.ticker, dp.name, dp.sector_name, st.name AS theme FROM domestic_product dp LEFT JOIN domestic_product_theme dpt ON dpt.domestic_product_id = dp.domestic_product_id LEFT JOIN stock_theme st ON st.stock_theme_id = dpt.stock_theme_id WHERE dp.type = 'STOCK' ORDER BY dp.ticker, st.name
